name: D'Alembert

claim_quotes: It cannot change the house edge
a run in which wins and losses are equal leaves you in profit
one of the safest, most sustainable systems

notes: NEEDS A REGISTERED MACHINE to backtest: +1 unit after a loss, -1 unit after a win, floored at 1 unit. This additive up/down progression is not expressible by the current schema (multiplier is multiplicative; ladder is a fixed table).
Source itself concedes 'It cannot change the house edge' — a rare honest disclaimer among hyped systems.
